manifest.b_u, b_v: the in-plane components of the flux density on the slice, T, packed on one range; draw them as arrows or trace field lines from them
manifest.b: flux density magnitude on the slice, T, packed
manifest.slice: the plane: its normal axis and position, the two in-plane axes and their ranges in mm
manifest.bodies: every body's name, role and box in mm
manifest.force: force (N) and torque (N m) on the target body
